hero.title: The New <safari>Safari</safari>
hero.description: The New Safari carries on the legendary lineage with contemporary and premium updates. The New Safari is a compelling combination of Grand Design, Cutting-edge Technology & Luxurious Comfort
hero.featureDescription: The new safari showcases an artistic sensibility that's sophisticated, assertive and way ahead of its time

tile1.title: New Parametric Grille
tile1.short: A bold parametric grille and signature lighting give the New Safari a commanding road presence from every angle.
tile1.expanded: The New Safari's front design combines a wide parametric grille with a confident upright stance and distinctive lighting signature. Sculpted surfaces and carefully integrated details create a modern interpretation of Safari's unmistakable road presence.

tile2.title: Luxurious Comfort
tile2.short: A spacious, refined cabin designed to make every journey comfortable — whether you're driving or relaxing in the rear.
tile2.expanded: Step inside a cabin designed around space, comfort and everyday usability. Generous seating, premium finishes and thoughtfully positioned controls create an inviting environment for both short city drives and long-distance journeys.

tile3.title: Effortless Everyday Access
tile3.short: Smart and convenient access to the luggage area makes loading and unloading effortless when your hands are full.
tile3.expanded: Everyday practicality is built into the New Safari. The large luggage area and convenient tailgate access make it easier to load shopping, luggage or travel essentials while keeping the experience simple and intuitive.

tile4.title: Distinctive From Every Angle
tile4.short: A distinctive rear light signature and sculpted proportions give the Safari an unmistakable presence even as it drives away.
tile4.expanded: The rear of the New Safari continues the confident design language of the front. A clean horizontal lighting signature emphasises its width, while strong surfaces and carefully detailed elements create a planted and sophisticated appearance.

tile5.title: Connected Digital Cockpit
tile5.short: An intuitive driver-focused cockpit brings information, entertainment and essential controls together in one refined space.
tile5.expanded: The New Safari places technology at the centre of the driving experience. Digital displays, intuitive controls and an intelligently organised dashboard keep important information within easy reach while maintaining a clean, premium interior design.

footer.title: Erobern Sie Ihr Leben zurück
footer.description: Für die Mutigen entwickelt. Für Komfort gefertigt. Entworfen, um Sie weiterzubringen.
